1.t: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

2.t: Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it.

3.t: And Who has measured (preordainments for everything even to be blessed or wretched); and then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as the wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture).

4.t: And Who brings out the pasturage,

5.t: And then makes it dark stubble.

6.t: We shall make you to recite (the Qur’ân), so you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall not forget (it),

7.t: Except what Allâh may will. He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.

8.t: And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).

9.t: Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).

10.t: The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allâh),

11.t: But it will be avoided by the wretched,

12.t: Who will enter the great Fire (and will be made to taste its burning).

13.t: There he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).

14.t: Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islâmic Monotheism) shall achieve success,

15.t: And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allâh), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawâfil - additional prayers).

16.t: Nay, you prefer the life of this world,

17.t: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

18.t: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures -

19.t: The Scriptures of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Mûsâ (Moses) (عليهما السلام).
